Manipur CM meets PM Modi and Amit Shah

Manipur Chief Minister N. Biren Singh met with Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union Home Minister Amit Shah in New Delhi. During these meetings, Singh sought the central government's support to restore peace in the northeastern state.
